history.name: What this release has collected so far
history.description: `ledger status` shows the release in progress: which features have been added, which changed, which withdrawn, and how many product-wide changes it holds. It is the check before presenting to a client — does the record reflect what actually got done this cycle — and the quick way to see whether work just finished has been written down.
history.dev_notes: cmdStatus; --json gives the same split as arrays of ids, for a script or a hook.
